_note: The 2 percent defence floor, MOVED at V3.2 from data/bloc-proposals/union_policy.json where V1.3d authored it as an EU proposal. Every term of it -- id, name, summary, position, constraint -- is unchanged; only the org it reaches changed, and with it the council that votes: eight members including GBR and excluding AUT and CHE, on the alliance's own roster. The floor it constrains is spending_defence, the tolerance and severity are the V1.3d numbers, and the eu's severity table now sums to 0.78 against BURDEN_MAX 1.0 -- the exact-sum property that table carried was a consequence of authoring four rules to fill the ceiling, and the move changes the authored set.

proposals.name: Common Defence Commitment
proposals.summary: Every member undertakes to hold defence spending at or above 2% of GDP. The commitment is political; the embarrassment of missing it is not.
